<DESCRIPTION>EXTENSION AND CONVERSION AGREEMENT BETWEEN VG LIFE SCIENCES, INC. AND MARTIN ERIC WEISBERG, DATED JANUARY 30, 2012
<TEXT>
<HTML>
<HEAD>
     <TITLE></TITLE>
</HEAD>
<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><B>Exhibit 10.68</B></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0; text-align: center"><B>EXTENSION AND CONVERSION AGREEMENT</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0.4in 0 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0.4in 0 0">Made this 30<SUP>th</SUP> day of January 2012 (the &quot;Effective
Date&quot;) by and between Viral Genetics, Inc., a Delaware corporation (the &quot;Company&quot;), and Martin Eric Weisberg (&quot;Consultant&quot;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0.4in 0 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>WHEREAS </B>Company and Consultant are party to an Amended and
Restated Consulting Agreement dated January 26, 2011 (the &quot;Agreement&quot;), pursuant to which Consultant is due certain compensation,
and the parties desire to extend the Agreement through December 31, 2012 and resolve such compensation due.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0.2in 0 0"><B>NOW, THEREFORE, </B>for good and lawful consideration
and of the mutual covenants contained herein and the mutual benefits to be derived hereunder, the parties agree as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0.2in 0 0"><B>&nbsp;</B></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">1.</TD><TD STYLE="padding-right: 0.1in">As of the Effective Date hereof, Consultant is owed a total of $135,000 pursuant to the Agreement
(&quot;Fees Due&quot;), as described on the attached Schedule A.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">2.</TD><TD>Consultant and Company hereby agree that the entire Fees Due shall be settled in shares of common stock of the Company (&quot;Shares&quot;)
at the price of $0.0195 per share, and Company shall therefore deliver a total of 6,923,070 Shares in full satisfaction of the
Fees Due within 20 business days of execution hereof, provided that these Shares shall be issued in certificates corresponding
to the period when the underlying portion of the Fees Due were earned, and services thereunder provided, as described in Schedule
A.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">3.</TD><TD STYLE="padding-right: 0.45in">The Term of the Agreement is hereby extended until December 31, 2012 as provided in Section 3
therein.</TD></TR></TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in">4.</TD><TD STYLE="padding-right: 0.05in">All other terms and conditions of the Consulting Agreement shall continue in full force and effect.<SUP>-</SUP></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0 0.05in 0 0.55in; text-indent: -0.25in">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0"><B>AGREED </B>and entered into as of the date affixed hereof.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 13.5pt; text-align: left; margin-bottom: 0; margin-left: 20pt"><B>COMPANY:</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; text-align: left; margin-left: 20pt"><B>VIRAL GENETICS, INC.</B></P>



<P STYLE="margin: 0 0 0 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0 0 0 20pt">By: <U>/s/ Haig Keledjian</U></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0 0 0 20pt">Duly Authorized Officer</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0 0 0 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0 0 0 20pt">CONSULTANT:</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0 0 0 20pt">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0 0 0 20pt"><U>/s/ Martin Eric Weisberg</U></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0 0 0 20pt">Martin Eric Weisberg</P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0 0 0 20pt">&nbsp;</P>
